An unnamed fire cookie with a black/red captain's hat and blond hair (purple frame, crossbow) appears in 84284 and 84116: not identified. Pets: green cactus-like = 와사비문어, bun with sauce = 핫도그, white round with red/green trim = 색동주머니; star numbers read from the pet badges.

posts.title_en: How does the volley buff work?
posts.summary_en: Asks whether volley buffs overwrite (Cheesecake 1, Chardonnay 2, Tiger Lily 3) and whether Tiger Lily is worth a slot for 2→3. 저장용: Tiger Lily is the core of conquest; he tried other dealers and came back to Tiger Lily. The main buffers are Milk, Cheesecake, Skating, Chardonnay, Tea Knight and Pomegranate; Pomegranate can't buff itself, so the five others plus Seeker must all receive straws. Base straws 3, with 다발2 only 5, so one misses; 다발3 from Tiger Lily gives 6. A buffer's skill amp adds more than a sub-dealer would.
mechanics: Volley buffs: the highest applies (implied: 다발2 from 샤르/허브 → 5 straws, 다발3 from 정전 → 6)
Straw recipients needed: 우유, 치케, 피겨, 샤르도네, 실론, 브시커 (석류 can't buff itself)
With only 다발2 one of the six misses a straw, which costs more than an extra sub-dealer adds

quotes.en: Because pulling up one more buffer's skill amp raises damage more than adding a dealer

quotes.kr: 메인 버퍼들이 우유 치케 피겨 샤르 실론 석류 이렇게 여섯명임. 석류는 본인이 버프 못받으니 빼고 메인딜러인 시커까지 딱 여섯명만 받으면 됨 여기서 한명이 못받으면 서브딜러 넣는것보다 딜이 안나옴
quotes.en: The main buffers are Milk, Cheesecake, Skating, Chardonnay, Tea Knight, Pomegranate. Pomegranate can't buff itself, so those plus main dealer Seeker, exactly six, need it; if one misses, damage falls below what a sub-dealer would add

quotes.kr: 근데 석류 기본 빨대가 3개밖에 안됨. 허브나 샤르는 다발2라서 얘네버프 받아봤자 빨대가 5개라 위에서 말한 6명중 하나가 석류빨대를 못받는 일이 발생함. 그래서 샤르가 다발2 있더라도 다발3인 정전을 넣어야만 하는 상황이 생김
quotes.en: But Pomegranate has only 3 base straws. Herb and Chardonnay are volley 2, so with their buff it's 5 straws and one of those six misses. So even with Chardonnay's volley 2 you must add Tiger Lily's volley 3

posts.title_en: Who is receiving Pomegranate's buff in conquest?
posts.summary_en: Asks how to tell at a glance who has a Pomegranate straw and whether 5 or 6 straws came out. Reply: check skill-amp values in cookie info.
mechanics: Straw count 5 vs 6 is the variable to watch; verify via skill-amp value in cookie info
